paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: Training loss curves for the post-training setting.
model_annotation: The plot displays the training loss curves for the post-training setting, illustrating how the loss decreases over iterations for different model configurations. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, labeled as "#Iteration," and spans from approximately 95,000 to 125,000, with major gridlines at intervals of 5,000. The y-axis represents the loss, ranging from 2.0 to 3.0, with major gridlines at intervals of 0.2. Four distinct lines are shown: a magenta line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)" starts at a loss of approximately 3.0 at 95,000 iterations and decreases to around 2.2 at 125,000 iterations; a dark blue line labeled "SepLLM (n=128)" starts at a loss of approximately 3.0 at 95,000 iterations and decreases to around 2.3 at 125,000 iterations; an orange line labeled "SepLLM (n=64)" starts at a loss of approximately 3.0 at 95,000 iterations and decreases to around 2.3 at 125,000 iterations; and a red dashed line labeled "Vanilla before post-training" remains constant at a loss of approximately 2.4 across the entire range of iterations.
